recap.text: Nami, a model and influencer who had surgery to look and sound like an old crawler, drives Eris. Nami is ejected from the ball of flesh and dissolved by fleshers. Carl kills the fleshers and Nami with a hob-lobber. Eris appears at Squirties with naga-like eyes and an Uzi Jesus toy.

beats.headline: How do I eject
beats.text: For the record: in the distance, Meatus shouts at Eris to stay out of this. A psychotic female laugh answers, then the same voice swearing. She said she did not want to come down to other floors. How does she eject? Get her out of here. She laughs again, crazier, and insists she is not the one laughing. Crawler Katia hears Hekla in it. Mordecai says someone new is driving Eris this year and has just been sucked back into the goddess's body by the new rule.
beats.gist: Nami is a model, influencer, and driver for Eris.

beats.headline: A face bought to match
beats.text: Rosetta supplies the name. Eris is sponsored by Nami, a model and influencer, who outbid the Priory; the Priory usually has a different priestess pilot Eris each season. The subject sounds like that old crawler because she had surgery to look and sound just like her. It is, Rosetta says, a thing. Eris herself looks a little like Hekla too. Crawler Donut wants to know whether there is one of her. Rosetta: they usually wait until the person is dead.
beats.gist: Rosetta says Nami, a model and influencer, sponsored Eris and had surgery to match an old crawler.

beats.headline: Out of the ball of flesh
beats.text: Something bursts out of the rolling ball of flesh as if from a blowhole: a person, arms waving, rocketing straight up and slamming into the grass. A human woman, off-worlder outline, no army glow. One slender arm rises for help. Baroness Victory does not know what to make of it, and Fopsy finds nothing in the ruleset for it. She crawls toward them, screaming soundlessly, in armor Crawler Carl half recognises. He asks Crawler Donut whether she cast Laundry Day. She did not.
beats.gist: A woman bursts from a ball of flesh and slams into the grass.

beats.headline: Taken by the fleshers
beats.text: Nami, influencer, is dead. Three fleshers fall off the ball and scuttle to her. The first wraps her legs and climbs her, dissolving her flesh, and her scream rises. Dong Quixote asks whether they should help. Crawler Carl says no: wait until it kills her. Baroness Victory recognises her then. Someone has stripped the goddess's soul armor, ejecting the driver. Crawler Carl works out that a war mage is inside the ball. The flesher stands up wearing her, a dromedarian skin draped over her like a ghost costume, and two more attach. Crawler Carl throws a hob-lobber. It kills her and the fleshers at once.
beats.gist: Three fleshers dissolve Nami; Carl kills the fleshers and Nami with a hob-lobber.

beats.headline: A fan at the gate
beats.text: At Squirties, Zander has a customer he did not hear dock: a tall, elf-like woman with a long neck and naga-like eyes, holding the Uzi Jesus toy. He compliments her costume, or surgery, then remembers what happened. Is she a fan of Nami? Shame what happened to her. Has she come to the gate to pay her respects? She asks whether he is asking Eris, goddess of chaos, if she is wearing a costume. She laughs, and snaps her fingers.
beats.gist: Zander meets Nami, a tall woman with naga-like eyes, who asks if he questions Eris.
